item.text: [{"task_id":"0d87d2a6","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    marker = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    object_color = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    unit = int(round(params['unit'][0]))","    directions = [(int(round(a)), int(round(b))) for a, b in params['directions']]","    height, width = grid.shape","    out = grid.copy()","    lines = np.zeros(grid.shape)","    for r in range(height):","        if grid[r, 0] == marker and grid[r, width - unit] == marker:","            lines[r, :] = unit","    for c in range(width):","        if grid[0, c] == marker and grid[height - unit, c] == marker:","            lines[:, c] = unit","    seen = set()","    for r in range(height):","        for c in range(width):","            if grid[r, c] != object_color or (r, c) in seen:","                continue","            component = [(r, c)]","            seen.add((r, c))","            pending = [(r, c)]","            hit = False","            while pending:","                a, b = pending.pop()","                if bool(lines[a, b]):","                    hit = True","                for dr, dc in directions:","                    x, y = a + dr, b + dc","                    if 0 <= x < height and 0 <= y < width:","                        if grid[x, y] == object_color and (x, y) not in seen:","                            seen.add((x, y))","                            component.append((x, y))","                            pending.append((x, y))","            if hit:","                for a, b in component:","                    out[a, b] = marker","    out[lines != 0] = marker","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[2],"unit":[1],"directions":[4,2]},"params":{"colors":[1,2],"unit":[1],"directions":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]},"rationale":"Connect matching blue markers on opposite borders with full horizontal or vertical blue lines. Recolor every connected red object intersected by any line entirely blue; preserve other objects."}]
